Item.Hint: Enter donation type or select from [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
chk varchar2(1);
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;


begin
if :ctrl_block.donation_type is null then
 show_error('16032');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;

 select 'x' into chk
 from valid_donation_types
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1);
 select description 
 into :ctrl_block.description
 from valid_donation_types
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1)
 and rownum < 2;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18035');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 chk number;
 l_eff_date date;
 l_term_date date;
 l_template_id varchar2(10):= null;
 active_tmp number ;
 future_tmp number;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

 procedure fill_eff_term_date is
 begin
 select eff_date,term_date 
 into :ctrl_block.eff_date,:ctrl_block.term_date
 from physical_findings_template
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type and
 template_id = :ctrl_block.template_id and 
 nvl(procedure_code,'X') = nvl(:ctrl_block.procedure_code,'X') and 
 rownum <2;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
/*Commented by Sobha per PR 001.020162
 show_error('18086');
 check_package_failure;*/
 null;
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; /* procedure ends */
 
begin /* main */
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;

 --message('in validate');pause;
 if :ctrl_block.template_id is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.template_id in ('NEW','new') 
 then 
 compute_active_future_count(active_tmp,future_tmp); /* check if both exists */
 if active_tmp > 0 and future_tmp > 0 then
 show_error('17017');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.eff_date',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.eff_date',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_NEW_TEMPL',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_UPDATE_TERM_DATE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('pft_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('pft_block',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_RETRIEVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :global.template := 'NEW';
 --:ctrl_block.term_date := NULL; 
 if active_tmp = 0 then
 :ctrl_block.eff_date := trunc( v_local_date);--sysdate
 :ctrl_block.hh_template_id := 'NEW'; 
 else
 :ctrl_block.hh_template_id := 'FUTURE'; 
 end if;
 end if;
if :ctrl_block.hh_template_id is not null then
 if :ctrl_block.template_id is not null and
 :ctrl_block.hh_template_id = 'INACTIVE' then
 fill_eff_term_date;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.eff_date',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.eff_date',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.term_date',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.term_date',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_NEW_TEMPL',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_RETRIEVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('pft_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('pft_block',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_UPDATE_TERM_DATE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 -- set_control_block_items('D');
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.template_id is not null and
 :ctrl_block.hh_template_id = 'ACTIVE'
 then
 fill_eff_term_date;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.eff_date',ITEM_IS_VALID,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.term_date',ITEM_IS_VALID,property_true);
 -- message('after item is valid');pause;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.eff_date',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.eff_date',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.term_date',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.term_date',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_NEW_TEMPL',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_RETRIEVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('pft_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('pft_block',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_UPDATE_TERM_DATE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_UPDATE_TERM_DATE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 -- set_control_block_items('D');
 end if; 

 if :ctrl_block.template_id is not null and
 :ctrl_block.hh_template_id = 'FUTURE' and
 :ctrl_block.template_id != 'NEW'
 then
 fill_eff_term_date;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.eff_date',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.eff_date',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.term_date',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.term_date',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_NEW_TEMPL',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_RETRIEVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('pft_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('pft_block',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_UPDATE_TERM_DATE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.PB_UPDATE_TERM_DATE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 --set_control_block_items('D');
 end if; 
end if;

end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 l_eff_date date := null;
 l_term_date date := null;
 l_template_id varchar2(10) := null;
 active_tmp number :=0;
 future_tmp number :=0;
 chk number;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

begin
 validate_eff_date;
 check_package_failure;
 compute_active_future_count(active_tmp,future_tmp); 
 /* check if both exists */

 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;

 if (:ctrl_block.template_id in ('NEW','new')) then
 if active_tmp > 0 and future_tmp = 0 then
 begin
 select eff_date,term_date,template_id 
 into l_eff_date,l_term_date,l_template_id
 from physical_findings_template
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type and
 nvl(procedure_code,'X') = nvl(:ctrl_block.procedure_code,'X') and
 (v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1)) and rownum <2;
 if (:ctrl_block.eff_date between l_eff_date and nvl(l_term_date,v_local_date+1) ) or
 (l_term_date is null) then
 set_alert_property('LOCAL_ALERT',alert_message_text,
 'Template:'||l_template_id||' is Active. Set termination date to '||
 to_char(:ctrl_block.eff_date -1,'MM-DD-YYYY') );
 chk := show_alert('LOCAL_ALERT');
 if chk = alert_button1 then
 --update_active_template(:ctrl_block.eff_date -1); /* Procedure to update term_date of active template */
 :global.update_term_date := 'Y';
 else 
 --execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 /* when others then
 null;*/
 end;
 end if; /* active >0 and future = 0 */ 

 if active_tmp = 0 and future_tmp > 0 then
 /* allow changes in the eff_date column 
 this will be updated by update term button */
 null;
 end if; /* active =0 and future >0 case */
 end if; /* new case */

 if :hh_template_id = 'FUTURE' then
 if active_tmp > 0 and future_tmp > 0 then
 begin
 select eff_date,term_date,template_id 
 into l_eff_date,l_term_date,l_template_id
 from physical_findings_template
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type and
 nvl(procedure_code,'X') = nvl(:ctrl_block.procedure_code,'X') and
 v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1) and
 rownum <2;
 if (:ctrl_block.eff_date between l_eff_date and nvl(l_term_date,v_local_date+1) ) or
 (l_term_date is null) then
 show_error('17023');
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 
 end;
 end if; /* case active >0 and future >0 */
 if active_tmp = 0 and future_tmp > 0 then
 null;
 end if; /* active_tmp = 0 and future > 0 */
 end if; /* future ends */
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 active_tmp number;
 future_tmp number;
 chk_count number;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

begin
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.term_date is not null then
 if :ctrl_block.term_date < :ctrl_block.eff_date then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.hh_template_id != 'INACTIVE' then
 if :ctrl_block.term_date < trunc(v_local_date) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 compute_active_future_count(active_tmp,future_tmp);
 if :ctrl_block.hh_template_id = 'ACTIVE' then
 if :global.fut_flag = 'CHECK' then
 if future_tmp > 0 then
 if :ctrl_block.term_date is null then
 show_error('17024');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 select count(*) 
 into chk_count
 from physical_findings_template
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type and
 nvl(procedure_code,'X') = nvl(:ctrl_block.procedure_code,'X') and
 template_id != :ctrl_block.template_id and
 :ctrl_block.term_date > eff_date ;
 if chk_count > 0 then
 show_error('17024');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 end if; 
 end if; /* global check */
 end if; /* active case */
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
chk_count number;
future_tmp number;
active_tmp number;
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

begin
 set_item_property('toolbar.commit_form',ENABLED,property_true);
 --proc_retrieve_data;
 --check_package_failure;
/* if :ctrl_block.term_date is null then
 show_error('17019');
 end if;
*/
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.eff_date > :ctrl_block.term_date then
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.term_date < trunc(v_local_date) then
 show_error('2314');
 end if;
 /*
 begin
 select count(*) into chk_count
 from physical_findings_template
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type and
 nvl(procedure_code,'X') = nvl(:ctrl_block.procedure_code,'X') and
 template_id != :ctrl_block.template_id and
 term_date is not null and 
 ( eff_date between :ctrl_block.eff_date and nvl(:ctrl_block.term_date,sysdate+1) or
 term_date between :ctrl_block.eff_date and nvl(:ctrl_block.term_date,sysdate+1) );
 if chk_count > 0 then
 --message('An active template already exists. cannot update ');
 show_error('17023'); 
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 */
------------------------------------------
 if :ctrl_block.hh_template_id ='FUTURE' then
 begin
 select count(*) --eff_date,term_date 
 into chk_count --fut_eff_date,fut_term_date
 from physical_findings_template
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type and
 nvl(procedure_code,'X') = nvl(:ctrl_block.procedure_code,'X') and
 template_id != :ctrl_block.template_id and
 ( v_local_date between eff_date and term_date ) and /* only active tmp */
 term_date > :ctrl_block.eff_date ;
 if chk_count > 0 then
 show_error('17023');
 end if;
 end;
 end if;
 ----------------------------------------- 
 if :ctrl_block.hh_template_id = 'ACTIVE' then
 compute_active_future_count(active_tmp,future_tmp);
 if future_tmp > 0 then
 if :ctrl_block.term_date is null then
 show_error('17024');
 end if;
 begin
 select count(*) --eff_date,term_date 
 into chk_count --fut_eff_date,fut_term_date
 from physical_findings_template
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type and
 nvl(procedure_code,'X') = nvl(:ctrl_block.procedure_code,'X') and
 template_id != :ctrl_block.template_id and
 eff_date > (v_local_date) and /* only future template */
 eff_date < :ctrl_block.term_date ;
 if chk_count > 0 then
 show_error('17024');
 end if;
 end;
 end if; 
 end if; /* active case */

 ----------------------------------------
 set_block_property('pft_block',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 go_block('pft_block');
 first_record;
 loop
 :pft_block.term_date := :ctrl_block.term_date ; 
 :pft_block.eff_date := :ctrl_block.eff_date;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 first_record; 
 set_block_property('pft_block',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_SELECTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_selection IS
rg_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'PF_GROUP'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 h_group_row_count number;
 ref_record_number number;
 curr_group_row number;
 flag number;
 errcode NUMBER; 
BEGIN
 flag := 0;
 rg_id := Find_Group(rg_name); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group( rg_id ); 
 END IF;
 rg_id := Find_Group(rg_name); 
 IF Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rg_id := Create_Group(rg_name);
 END IF;
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'DONATION_TYPE',CHAR_COLUMN,5); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'PROCEDURE_CODE',CHAR_COLUMN,5); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'PHYSICAL_CODE',CHAR_COLUMN,10); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'DESCRIPTION',CHAR_COLUMN,50); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'BOX_NUMBER',CHAR_COLUMN,3); 

 -- gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'ITEM_OPERATOR',CHAR_COLUMN,10); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'EFF_DATE',DATE_COLUMN); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'TERM_DATE',DATE_COLUMN); 
 
 go_block('valid_physical_rules');
 first_record;
 loop
 if :valid_physical_rules.chkbox = 'Y' then
 add_group_row(rg_id,END_OF_GROUP);
 curr_group_row := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.DONATION_TYPE',curr_group_row,:valid_physical_rules.donation_type);
 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.PROCEDURE_CODE',curr_group_row,:ctrl_block.procedure_code);
 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.PHYSICAL_CODE',curr_group_row,:valid_physical_rules.physical_code);

 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.DESCRIPTION',curr_group_row,
 :valid_physical_rules.s_physical_code_desc);
 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.box_number',curr_group_row,
 to_char(:valid_physical_rules.box_number) );
 -- set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.ITEM_OPERATOR',curr_group_row,:valid_physical_rules.item_operator); 
 set_group_date_cell('PF_GROUP.EFF_DATE',curr_group_row,:ctrl_block.eff_date);
 set_group_date_cell('PF_GROUP.TERM_DATE',curr_group_row,:ctrl_block.term_date);
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 /* populate user selection back to hhtemplate */
 hide_window('window2');
 h_group_row_count := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 go_block('pft_block');
 set_block_property('pft_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_true);
 last_record;
 ref_record_number := to_number(:system.cursor_record);
 if :system.record_status = 'NEW' then
 flag := 1;
 end if;
 for i in 1 .. h_group_row_count
 loop 
 if flag = 0 then
 create_record;
 end if;
 :pft_block.donation_type := get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.DONATION_TYPE',i); 
 :pft_block.procedure_code := get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.PROCEDURE_CODE',i); 
 :pft_block.physical_code := get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.PHYSICAL_CODE',i); 
 :pft_block.physical_code_desc := get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.DESCRIPTION',i);
 :pft_block.box_number := to_number(get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.BOX_NUMBER',i)); 
 -- :pft_block.item_operator := get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.ITEM_OPERATOR',i); 
 :pft_block.eff_date := get_group_date_cell('PF_GROUP.eff_date',i); 
 :pft_block.term_date := get_group_date_cell('PF_GROUP.term_date',i); 
 :pft_block.donation_type := :ctrl_block.donation_type;
 :pft_block.template_id := :ctrl_block.template_id;
 if flag = 1 then
 create_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group( rg_id ); 
 END IF; 
 go_record(ref_record_number); 
END;

PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;

BEGIN
 if :global.donation_type != :pft_block.donation_type or
 :global.procedure_code != :pft_block.procedure_code or
 :global.physical_code != :pft_block.physical_code or

 if :global.donation_type = :pft_block.donation_type and

 :global.physical_code = :pft_block.physical_code and
 :global.template_id = :pft_block.template_id then

 ','||:global.procedure_code||
 ','||:global.physical_code||
 ','||:global.template_id||',','D',chk);

 if :global.donation_type = :pft_block.donation_type and
 :global.procedure_code = :pft_block.procedure_code and

 if :pft_block.donation_type is not null and
 :pft_block.procedure_code is not null and
 :pft_block.physical_code is not null and
 :pft_block.template_id is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM physical_findings_template
 WHERE donation_type = :pft_block.donation_type and
 procedure_code = :pft_block.procedure_code and
 physical_code = :pft_block.physical_code and
 template_id = :pft_block.template_id;

 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then

 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C05C10',:pft_block.donation_type||
 ','||:pft_block.procedure_code||
 ','||:pft_block.physical_code||
 ','||:pft_block.template_id||',','U',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 MESSAGE('Err2. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;
 /*
 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 MESSAGE('Err3. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 else
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C05C10',:pft_block.donation_type||
 ','||:pft_block.procedure_code||
 ','||:pft_block.physical_code||
 ','||:pft_block.template_id||',','U',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 MESSAGE('Err4. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if; record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
 end if; /* all condition anded if */
END;

PROCEDURE populate_physical_rules IS
cursor pft_questions(p_local_date in date) is
 Select distinct donation_type,procedure_code,physical_code
 from valid_physical_rules
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type and
 procedure_code = :ctrl_block.procedure_code and 
 p_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,p_local_date+1)
 order by physical_code;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

BEGIN
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;

 go_block('valid_physical_rules');
 first_record; 
 For c1 in pft_questions(v_local_date)
 loop
 :valid_physical_rules.donation_type := c1.donation_type;
 :valid_physical_rules.procedure_code := c1.procedure_code;
 :valid_physical_rules.physical_code := c1.physical_code;
 begin
 select description,sort_sequence_3
 into :valid_physical_rules.s_physical_code_desc,
 :valid_physical_rules.box_number 
 from valid_master_codes
 where 
 code = c1.physical_code and
 code_type = 'PHYCD' and
 v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_local_date+1) and
 rownum < 2;
 exception
 when others then
 null;
 end; 
 create_record;
 end loop; /* cursor for loop ends */
 delete_record;
 first_record;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMPUTE_ACTIVE_FUTURE_COUNT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE compute_active_future_count
 (active_count OUT number,
 future_count OUT number)
IS
 active_tmp number;
 future_tmp number;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;


BEGIN
begin /* check for active template */
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;

 select count(*) into active_tmp
 from physical_findings_template
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type and
 nvl(procedure_code,'X') = nvl(:ctrl_block.procedure_code,'X') and 
 (v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1) ) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end; 
 
 begin /* future template */
 select count(*) into future_tmp
 from physical_findings_template
 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type and
 nvl(procedure_code,'X') = nvl(:ctrl_block.procedure_code,'X') and 
 eff_date > trunc(v_local_date) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;
 active_count := active_tmp;
 future_count := future_tmp;
END;

v_local_date date;

 else

 select eff_date,term_date , 
 decode(term_date,null,
 decode(least(eff_date, trunc(v_local_date )),eff_date,
 'ACTIVE',
 'FUTURE'),
 decode(least(eff_date,trunc(v_local_date )),trunc(v_local_date ),
 'FUTURE',

 )
 )

 :ctrl_block.hh_template_id

 where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type and
 template_id = :ctrl_block.template_id and 
 nvl(procedure_code,'X') = nvl(:ctrl_block.procedure_code,'X') and 
 rownum <2;
 exception

 show_error('18086');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; /* procedure ends */
END;

 donation_type,
 procedure_code, 
 'FUTURE',
 to_char(eff_date,'MM-DD-YYYY'), to_char(term_date,'MM-DD-YYYY')
 from physical_findings_template
where donation_type = :ctrl_block.donation_type
 and nvl(procedure_code,'X') = nvl(:ctrl_block.procedure_code,'X') 
 and eff_date > :ctrl_block.chp_sysdate order by 4

RecordGroup.Name: RB_INTER_CODE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select 
 inter_code,
 inter_desc
 from valid_interdictions
 where :ctrl_block.chp_sysdate between eff_date 
 and nvl(term_date,:ctrl_block.chp_sysdate+1)
 order by inter_code

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DONATION_TYPE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select donation_type,
 description
 from valid_donation_types
 where :ctrl_block.chp_sysdate between eff_date 
 and nvl(term_date,:ctrl_block.chp_sysdate+1) 
 order by sort_sequence

 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
chk number;
new_temp_id varchar2(10);
chk_p varchar2(1);
begin
 validate(form_scope);
 if not form_success then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := '10';
 if :ctrl_block.hh_template_id in ('ACTIVE','NEW') then
 set_alert_property('local_alert',ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,
 'Do you want to make this set of questions a current template ?');
 elsif :ctrl_block.hh_template_id = 'FUTURE' then
 set_alert_property('local_alert',ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,
 'Do you want to make this set of questions a future template ?');
 else
 show_error('17018');
 end if;
 if :global.update_term_date = 'Y' then
 update_active_template(:ctrl_block.eff_date -1);
 end if;
 chk := show_alert('local_alert');
 if chk = ALERT_BUTTON1 then 
 set_block_property('pft_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('pft_block',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 check_password(:banner.prog_name,chk_p);
 if chk_p = 'Y' then
 commit_form;
 if form_success then
 show_error('9163');
 end if;
 end if;

 set_block_property('pft_block',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 else
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.hh_template_id = 'NEW' then
 set_block_property('pft_block',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('pft_block',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 end if; 
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
end;
